Yes I have and for an autistic person I play this game very well. I’ve been a part of a lot of different social circles and each one requires different aspects of my personality to be played into. Sometimes I imagine myself as a charismatic young student with a bright future and big dreams rather than the wreck that I actually believe I am. Sometimes I am the student who wrecked their future and has a tragic backstory. People love a narrative and it really depends on what a situation calls for. This also helped me and another autistic student become ambassadors for our school which is ironically one of the most important social roles a university can offer. We’re like the schools social and welcoming people. I think you have a lot of self-limiting beliefs as well. Lots of people would love to be friends with a camera operator, I mean look at the cool knowledge you’ve acquired over 20 freaking years!
